description: Set the signature added to outgoing mail. Stored on the mailbox, so it applies to every client that reads it.

account.description: Which mailbox to use. Defaults to the first. Pass the Mailbox shown in a list result when acting on that email.

html.description: Optional HTML version. Built from the text when omitted.

text.description: Plain-text signature, one item per line, name first.

name: set_signature
